limitations: This is a synthetic source review, not native integration, a learning run, a calibration, a performance benchmark or a gate.
The ordinary native API does not yet expose the two most recent raw RGB frames. The caller must supply the correct causal pair; this module cannot attest its external provenance.
Stream IDs, epochs and clocks remain caller provenance. Epoch changes must follow an agent-decided memory reset, never automatic use of an ALE reset/life/death counter.
A late transition_prediction rejection does not roll back already accepted observations. A future runner must preserve all paid charges and stop a failed learning update.
Private history is detached, but returned PerceptionFrame objects contain live autograd graphs. A future training loop must manage graph lifetime and parameter-update boundaries.

I uses current-weight embeddings with endogenous track decisions recorded earlier; these IDs are not independent truth. Exact feature collapse and weak/ambiguous P targets remain documented limitations of the component objectives.
